title: NotImplementedError in map_actuals_to_formals
body:
When I run mypy (0.4 or git master with Python 3.5) with `--check-untyped-defs` over [qutebrowser](https://github.com/The-Compiler/qutebrowser), I get:


I wasn't able to construct a minimal example which fails in the same way, but it fails [on this line](https://github.com/The-Compiler/qutebrowser/blob/37b5f49c8542c04e7aae6ded6e8ab0c6aa5f2010/qutebrowser/browser/webpage.py#L344):

``` python
    @pyqtSlot('QWebFrame*', 'QWebPage::Feature')
    def on_feature_permission_requested(self, frame, feature):
        """Ask the user for approval for geolocation/notifications."""
        options = {
            QWebPage.Notifications: ('content', 'notifications'),
            QWebPage.Geolocation: ('content', 'geolocation'),
        }
        config_val = config.get(*options[feature])  # <-----
        # [...]
```

Some interesting locals from a `--pdb` session:

```
>>> argt.items
[builtins.str, builtins.str]
>>> j
1
>>> ncallee
2
>>> callee_kinds
[2, 4]
```

Seems like the `4` for the current argument (`j=1`) is `nodes.UNBOUND_TVAR`.
